package etcd

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"galactus/metrics"
	"galactus/utils"
	"net/url"
	"regexp"
	"slices"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"sync/atomic"
	"time"

	"galactus/pkg/logger"

	servicev1 "github.com/ShareChat/nexus-proto/nexus/v1/service"
	"github.com/ShareChat/nexus-proto/validator"
	grpc_retry "github.com/grpc-ecosystem/go-grpc-middleware/v2/interceptors/retry"
	grpc_timeout "github.com/grpc-ecosystem/go-grpc-middleware/v2/interceptors/timeout"
	grpc_prometheus "github.com/grpc-ecosystem/go-grpc-prometheus"
	"github.com/rs/zerolog/log"
	"go.etcd.io/etcd/api/v3/v3rpc/rpctypes"
	clientv3 "go.etcd.io/etcd/client/v3"
	"google.golang.org/grpc"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/keepalive"
)

var IsDiscoveryReady atomic.Bool
var DiscoveryInNotReadyStateCount atomic.Int32
var PrimaryEtcdClientReady atomic.Bool
var primaryEtcdCheckInProgress atomic.Bool
var EtcdConnectionState atomic.Value // stores string, e.g. "READY", "TRANSIENT_FAILURE"

type AdapterV2Interface interface {
	GetEndpoints(secondaryClient bool) (map[string]string, error)
	GetEndpointKey(endpoint *servicev1.ServiceEndpoint) string
	GetEndpointsPodUIDs() (map[string]string, error)
	Register(endpoint *servicev1.ServiceEndpoint, isLRC bool) error
	Deregister(endpoint *servicev1.ServiceEndpoint, leaseTTL int64) error
	Delete(endpointKey string) error
	DeleteExact(endpointKey string) error
	DeleteNode(clusterName, node string) error
	GetRegisteredNodes(clusterName string) (map[string]bool, error)
	GetMultiEntityServices() *sync.Map
	GetMultiEntityEnabled() bool
	SetMultiEntityServices(services string)
	CleanSecondaryService(serviceName string) error
	PutLRCSpec(key string, value []byte) error
	DeleteLRCSpec(key string) error
	Close()
}

type AdapterV2 struct {
	zonalHosts          []string
	allHosts            []string
	secondaryHosts      []string
	Client              *clientv3.Client
	SecondaryClient     *clientv3.Client
	MultiEntityEnabled  *atomic.Bool
	MultiEntityServices *sync.Map       // map[string]bool
	ctx                 context.Context // parent context for all operations; cancelled when quit closes
}

type EtcdEndpoint struct {
	Host string
	Zone string
}

      - 15090,15021,15020
      - -k
